products.name: Pre-filled Culture Media Filling Line
products.shortDesc: Automated aseptic filling line for pre-poured culture media, ideal for clinical and industrial microbiology testing.
products.fullDesc: Our pre-filled culture media filling line is designed for the aseptic dispensing of media used in clinical and industrial microbiology testing. Compatible with 90 mm, 70 mm and 55 mm petri dishes, it delivers high-speed automated dispensing and convenient packaging, significantly reducing contamination risk during filling.

products.name: Biochemical Reagent Filling Line (Mid-speed)
products.shortDesc: Mid-speed filling line engineered for diagnostic and biochemical reagents, balancing speed and precision.
products.fullDesc: A mid-speed filling line for the diagnostic reagent industry, suitable for various reagent bottle sizes. It provides precise filling, capping and labeling in one integrated process, ensuring batch consistency and cleanliness.

products.name: Biologics Filling Line
products.shortDesc: Automated filling solution for biologics and diagnostic reagents in a high-cleanliness environment.
products.fullDesc: Engineered for high-value biologics, this line delivers fully automated bottle feeding, filling, stoppering and capping, meeting the highest requirements for cleanliness and consistency.

products.name: Liquid Culture Media Filling Line
products.shortDesc: Dedicated liquid-media line integrating washing, drying and filling for higher efficiency.
products.fullDesc: Integrates bottle washing, drying and filling into a continuous line for liquid media and buffer solutions, improving productivity while reducing manual intervention.

products.name: Single-station Tube Filling & Capping Machine
products.shortDesc: Compact single-station unit for filling and sealing tubes, vials and centrifuge containers.
products.fullDesc: A compact single-station tube filling and capping machine designed for tubular containers. It integrates automatic tube feeding, quantitative filling and capping in one space-saving, easy-to-operate unit.

products.name: Dual-station Tube Filling & Capping Machine
products.shortDesc: Dual-station capper that doubles throughput for high-volume reagent tube production.
products.fullDesc: Building on the single-station design, the dual-station unit roughly doubles output, ideal for high-volume tubular product manufacturing with stable filling accuracy and seal integrity.

products.name: Vial Filling–Stoppering–Crimping Machine
products.shortDesc: Pharmaceutical vial system integrating filling, stoppering and crimping to GMP standards.
products.fullDesc: Purpose-built for pharmaceutical vials, this machine integrates bottle feeding, filling, stoppering and crimping in one line, complying with pharmaceutical cleanroom production requirements.

faq.question: What industries do your filling machines serve?
faq.answer: Our equipment serves IVD/diagnostics, pharmaceutical, daily-chemical, food & beverage and general liquid-packaging applications.

faq.question: Do you provide customized production lines?
faq.answer: Yes. We engineer solutions around your container type, target speed, dosing accuracy and cleanroom requirements.

faq.question: What are your lead times and minimum order quantity?
faq.answer: Standard models are available with short lead times; customized lines are quoted case by case. MOQ is 1 unit.

faq.question: Which standards do your machines meet?
faq.answer: Equipment is built to CE, ISO 9001 and GMP cleanroom standards, with full documentation provided.

faq.question: Do you support overseas installation and training?
faq.answer: Yes — we provide remote guidance and on-site service, plus English manuals and a recommended spare-parts list.

faq.question: What after-sales support do you provide?
faq.answer: 24/7 technical support, spare-parts supply and lifetime maintenance advice back every machine we ship.
